rows: Weekly & monthly performance – campaign → ad set → ad

Pick the metric in the yellow cell. Weeks are calendar weeks of the month: W1 = 1st–7th, W2 = 8th–14th, W3 = 15th–21st, W4 = 22nd–28th, W5 = 29th–end. Δ next to a week = change vs the week before (W1 compares with the previous month's last week); MoM = month vs previous month. For cost metrics green = cheaper; for volumes green = more. Use the + / − buttons on the left to open ad sets and ads.
